---
name: Hardware validation record
about: Report supervised results without treating build success as physical acceptance
---

## Hardware and software

Public model/controller versions, software commit and configuration changes (no unique device IDs):

## Preconditions

Which joint mapping, zero, limits, stop path, PWM bounds, TCP and camera extrinsics were verified?

## Procedure and evidence

Describe the supervised steps, measured quantities and failure/recovery behavior.
Distinguish command ACK, physical arrival, grasp, lift and return completion.

## Remaining uncertainty

Identify untested modes and limitations. Do not upload unlicensed CAD or private scene recordings.
